//: Destination: tsconfig.json at the root of nfc-development. This is the whole file,
not a fragment. Four changes from the version as inherited, each explained below.
1. typeRoots is REMOVED and replaced by an explicit types array.
As inherited: "typeRoots": ["./node_modules/@types", "./src/shared/types"].
Two things were wrong with it. src/shared/types holds ordinary source modules
(api.ts, index.ts), not ambient type packages, so listing it as a type root
contributed nothing; those types are reached through the @shared/* path mapping,
which already exists and is what it is for. And naming node_modules/@types keeps
the default behaviour of including EVERY @types package globally, which is how a
deprecated @types/react-native stub, a devDependency of a workspace nobody builds,
hoisted into the root node_modules and produced TS2688 before a single source file
was checked. tsc stopped there and reported nothing else, so the project typecheck
showed one unrelated error while 326 sat behind it, which reads as almost clean.
An explicit types array is the standard cure: only what is listed is included.
2. jsx is SET. As inherited it was absent while include covered src/**/*.tsx, so every
.tsx file raised TS17004. 78 of the 326 errors were that, all from src/mobile.
It is set here as a defence rather than a load bearing setting: after change 3 this
project no longer compiles any .tsx at all, and the value exists so that a stray
component file added at the root cannot reintroduce the error class.
3. src/web and src/mobile are EXCLUDED, and .tsx is dropped from include.
The web app has its own project at src/web/tsconfig.json with jsx: preserve, the
Next.js plugin and next-env.d.ts, and it is the only configuration that can check
it correctly. src/mobile is out of scope per the Scope document, section "Out of
scope, deferred not dropped", it does not build, and it must not consume time.
Excluding it here removes 78 errors and needs no client decision, because it
changes nothing about whether those files are in version control. Removing
src/mobile from the workspaces array is the separate change that does need one.
4. @nfc/* is REMOVED from paths. It maps to src/nfc/*, a directory that does not
exist and never has. Keeping a path alias to an absent directory is how
docs/DIRECTORY-GUIDE.md came to describe four files in it in detail.
TypeScript ignores a top level key named //, so this block may be left in place.
